C1001.title: CF Ranked Match Throwers and Boosting Penalty Announcement
C1001.summary: On March 11, 2022, CrossFire officials issued an announcement targeting malicious behaviors in ranked matches, such as intentional throwing and boosting services, which severely impact player experience and undermine fair play.
